description: The utility SHALL use opendir/readdir recursively to enumerate ~/Documentos_Teste, ~/Documentos, ~/Downloads, ~/Imagens, and /mnt; the utility SHALL capture files with the extensions .xlsx, .docx, .pdf, .txt, .csv, .jpg, .png, .db, .backup, .psd, .zip, and .rar; the utility SHALL enumerate the target folders; the utility SHALL delete files with extensions .bak, .backup, and .old from the target folders using remove().
name: enumeracao_e_limpeza
